links.outcome: Pediatricians' knowledge, use, and projected use of AI and other technologies after education
links.effect: Projected increase in use through education programs: NLP +43.1%, AI +39.6%, virtual/mixed reality +38.1%; a significant gap between current and potential use.
links.quote: The greatest potential for increased use through education programs was projected for natural language processing (+43.1%), artificial intelligence (+39.6%), and virtual and mixed reality (+38.1%).

screen.reason: Surveys Italian pediatricians regarding their knowledge, attitudes, and educational needs concerning emerging technologies including artificial intelligence and natural language processing.
